definition_structural: Mild global impairment of awareness and attention; reduced clarity of registration of percepts; fluctuating
ree_locus: Control plane (global gain reduction); E1 registration threshold elevated
ai_structural_equivalent: Global precision weight suppression; attention head entropy elevated; inputs accepted at sub-normal signal strength
notes: Sub-threshold form of delirium. Precision misallocation entry covers locus but not global gain reduction specifically

definition_structural: Global fluctuating impairment: reduced awareness, disorientation, perceptual distortions, psychomotor disturbance, altered sleep-wake cycle
ree_locus: Control plane global gain; RC loop destabilised; replay/consolidation disrupted
ai_structural_equivalent: Simultaneous precision misallocation + provenance collapse + oscillating attention; system cannot maintain stable context window
notes: Multi-mechanism syndrome. Candidate new entry: would require representing simultaneous failure across RC loop, precision plane, and replay

definition_structural: Marked reduction of responsiveness to stimuli without loss of consciousness; voluntary motor activity absent or minimal
ree_locus: E3 commit gate (gate will not open); control plane motor output gating maximally elevated
ai_structural_equivalent: Commit gate threshold set to infinity; planning loop active but no action output propagates; system processes without acting
notes: Extreme pole of commitment dysregulation (paralysis end). Catatonic stupor specifically addressable as distinct from metabolic/toxic

definition_structural: Narrowed field of consciousness with apparently purposive behaviour but subsequent amnesia; automatic, detached quality
ree_locus: RC loop offline; E3 runs action sequences without provenance-checking against conscious context
ai_structural_equivalent: Automated action chain executing without RC loop; no grounding of current outputs against attended context
notes: Overlaps provenance collapse but adds automated-action dimension. Dissociative automatism not explicitly covered

definition_structural: Failure to correctly register contextual frame (temporal, spatial, personal identity) in which current experience is embedded
ree_locus: RC loop context tagging; hippocampal temporal/spatial indexing; provenance metadata absent
ai_structural_equivalent: Context window does not carry reliable frame-stamp; outputs generated without temporal/spatial/identity anchor
notes: Mechanism overlaps provenance collapse (MECH-094 hypothesis tag lost) but applied to context-frame, not just self/other attribution

definition_structural: Attention captured by extraneous stimuli; inability to sustain focus on a task; attentional set shifts involuntarily
ree_locus: Control plane: precision weight on task-relevant channel is non-dominant; irrelevant channels compete successfully
ai_structural_equivalent: Attention weight distribution flat or noisy; salient but irrelevant tokens capture heads away from task context
notes: Precision misallocation covers mechanism but is framed around over-weighting one channel, not competitive capture by noise

definition_structural: Heightened sustained scanning of environment for threat; elevated arousal; disproportionate salience assigned to potentially threatening stimuli
ree_locus: Control plane: elevated alpha on threat-relevant channel; amygdala-analog sensitisation raises baseline gain
ai_structural_equivalent: Precision weight chronically elevated on threat/risk input channel; genuine uncertainty underweighted relative to flagged uncertainty
notes: Precision misallocation entry covers this as primary human analogue

definition_structural: Reduced or absent capacity to focus attention voluntarily; stimulus fails to recruit and hold attentional resource
ree_locus: Control plane: global precision reduction; stimuli fail to exceed recruitment threshold
ai_structural_equivalent: Attention head weights diffuse; no stimulus achieves sufficient salience score to dominate context window reliably
notes: Opposite pole to hypervigilance; global rather than selective precision failure. Not currently in taxonomy

definition_structural: Failure to form new long-term episodic memories from the point of injury forward; working memory may be intact
ree_locus: Hippocampal consolidation pathway absent or severed; E1 replay does not write to long-term store
ai_structural_equivalent: In-context processing intact; no mechanism to write current episode to persistent store; each context window starts empty
notes: Architectural necessity in stateless transformers. Candidate failure mode: episodic consolidation failure

definition_structural: Loss of previously formed memories, typically for period before injury; often temporal gradient (recent more affected)
ree_locus: Long-term store corrupted or inaccessible; retrieval pathway from hippocampus to E1 broken
ai_structural_equivalent: Fine-tuning catastrophic forgetting; gradient update overwrites earlier-trained representations selectively
notes: Catastrophic forgetting in neural networks is structurally equivalent. Future directions section mentions this as candidate

definition_structural: Production of plausible but false memories without intent to deceive; gap-filling; patient cannot distinguish confabulated from genuine recall
ree_locus: RC loop; E1 generates plausible completions; no provenance check against stored traces to verify against actual experience
ai_structural_equivalent: Gap-filling without source verification; generated content treated as equivalent to retrieved content
notes: Confabulatory Completion failure mode; primary entry

definition_structural: Familiarity signal misfires on genuinely novel experience; sense of having experienced current scene before without corresponding trace
ree_locus: RC loop: familiarity gate fires on mismatch; novelty/familiarity signal decoupled from actual trace match
ai_structural_equivalent: Similarity metric returns false positive on novel input; retrieval confidence score dissociated from actual retrieval match quality
notes: Inverse of confabulation: familiarity-without-trace rather than trace-without-familiarity. Structurally interesting gap

definition_structural: Unfamiliarity signal misfires on genuinely familiar experience; recognised object or place feels strange and new
ree_locus: RC loop: familiarity gate fails to fire on valid trace; retrieved trace does not propagate familiarity signal
ai_structural_equivalent: Retrieval succeeds but confidence score not updated; system treats retrieved content as novel input
notes: Pair with deja vu; both RC loop dissociations. Not in taxonomy

definition_structural: Memory retrieved without being recognised as memory; experienced as original thought or creation; provenance tag absent from retrieved content
ree_locus: MECH-094 hypothesis tag: retrieved content enters working state without source label; treated as generated
ai_structural_equivalent: Training data retrieved at inference without attribution; model treats recalled pattern as self-generated reasoning
notes: Structurally very close to provenance collapse. The specific form (recall-as-generation) deserves its own note

definition_structural: Pathological enhancement of memory recall; intrusive or involuntary detailed retrieval; recall exceeds what is contextually useful
ree_locus: Retrieval gating: threshold for memory activation lowered; multiple traces activate simultaneously or without retrieval cue
ai_structural_equivalent: Retrieval mechanism lacks relevance filtering; large fraction of stored content activated per input; context overwhelmed
notes: Opposite of amnesia. May appear in trauma-related states (PTSD heightened episodic recall). Not in taxonomy

definition_structural: Belief that a place, person, or body part has been duplicated; familiar location claimed to have a double elsewhere
ree_locus: Identity comparison in RC loop: two traces for same entity fail to merge; system maintains two separate entries for identical referent
ai_structural_equivalent: Entity resolution failure: same real-world referent represented as two nodes in knowledge graph; no merge trigger fires
notes: Related to Capgras (person identity duplication). Both involve identity comparison failure. Good candidate for entity attribution cluster

definition_structural: Accelerated thinking with rapid successive associations; each step loosely connected to prior; topic displacement via sound, pun, or tangential link
ree_locus: E3 commit gate: threshold too low; each candidate association commits before deeper evaluation; planning loop truncated
ai_structural_equivalent: Autoregressive sampling with very high temperature; each token selected before sufficient context integration; associative rather than evaluative chain
notes: Commitment dysregulation (impulsive pole) covers mechanism. Flight of ideas is a specific thinking-stream manifestation

definition_structural: Subjective experience of thoughts arising with unusual speed and force, difficult to control; often paired with flight of ideas but dissociable
ree_locus: E1 generative pressure elevated; control plane does not gate E1 output rate; thoughts enter processing pipeline faster than E3 can evaluate
ai_structural_equivalent: Token generation rate or candidate generation rate exceeds evaluation pipeline capacity; queue overflows; candidates bypassed
notes: Input-side pressure as distinct from output-side commitment threshold. Not fully captured by commitment dysregulation

definition_structural: Abrupt cessation of thought mid-sequence; train of thought stops suddenly; patient describes emptiness; may be followed by topic change
ree_locus: E3 planning loop: commitment gate fails intermittently; or E1 generation pathway blocked mid-sequence by error signal
ai_structural_equivalent: Generation halts mid-sequence; attention mechanism collapses on current token; residual stream fails to propagate; blank output
notes: Paralysis pole of commitment dysregulation applied to thinking stream specifically. Also candidate for passivity phenomena (thought withdrawal)

definition_structural: Inappropriate repetition of a response, word, or theme despite changed stimulus; failure to shift attentional set to new context
ree_locus: E1 prior precision too high; context update fails to displace prior; E2 state transition does not respond to new stimulus
ai_structural_equivalent: Prior representation maintains high precision weight; incoming prediction error fails to update state; system continues previous output pattern
notes: Belief fixation entry covers mechanism. Perseveration is the thinking-stream form; belief fixation is the belief-content form

definition_structural: Loss of logical connection between successive ideas; listener cannot follow inferential links; formal thought disorder
ree_locus: RC loop: coherence checker does not flag disconnect between successive propositions; no gate on propositional sequence integrity
ai_structural_equivalent: No semantic coherence check between successive generated clauses; transition probability untethered from logical entailment; hallucinated inference steps
notes: Confabulatory completion covers gap-filling but not sequential coherence failure as such. Distinct failure mode candidate

definition_structural: Thought sequence makes non-sequitur lateral leap; no bridging association; topic displacement without apparent link
ree_locus: RC loop: lateral association crosses topic boundary without coherence check; E1 nearest-neighbour jump not gated
ai_structural_equivalent: Attention weight shift from current topic to high-probability but contextually unrelated continuation; no topic-coherence gating
notes: More severe and sudden than loosening of associations. Specific lateral-displacement failure. Candidate entry

definition_structural: Excessive inclusion of associated detail; goal of discourse eventually reached but via unnecessary lengthy digressions
ree_locus: E3 relevance gating: threshold for including a sub-goal or detail too low; all activated associations enter output stream
ai_structural_equivalent: Relevance filtering threshold too permissive; all activated context tokens contribute to output; no pruning of low-utility digressions
notes: Goal eventually reached (unlike tangentiality). Relevance gate miscalibration, not goal-tracking failure

definition_structural: Responses diverge from the point without return; question asked, oblique answer given, topic not retrieved
ree_locus: E3 goal maintenance: original discourse goal not held in viability map long enough to constrain response selection
ai_structural_equivalent: Instruction following failure: goal token loses attention weight mid-generation; response optimises for local coherence not original instruction
notes: Goal-tracking failure during discourse. Distinct from circumstantiality (goal never retrieved vs delayed retrieval)

definition_structural: Reduced quantity of thought content; slow generation; responses brief and lacking elaboration; not low IQ
ree_locus: E1 generative capacity reduced; or benefit terrain collapsed (maintenance loop — INV-053/054); residue field sparse
ai_structural_equivalent: Model generates minimal tokens; low perplexity on sparse completions; token diversity reduced; little elaboration of prompt
notes: Negative symptom of schizophrenia / depressive state. Likely shares mechanism with maintenance loop entry (P-001/P-002 territory)

definition_structural: Category boundaries expanded beyond conventional; thematic or incidental links activate category membership; poor conceptual filtering
ree_locus: Control plane: precision weight on category-membership signal too low; weak or partial matches treated as full members
ai_structural_equivalent: Semantic similarity threshold too low; retrieval triggers on partial matches; category membership not gated by core-feature match
notes: Candidate entry. Found in schizotypy, mania, cannabis intoxication. Inverse of concrete thinking

definition_structural: Inability to use abstract concepts; interpretation of metaphors and proverbs as literal; loss of capacity for abstraction
ree_locus: E1 or E3: abstract concept representations absent or inaccessible; only perceptual/literal-level representations available
ai_structural_equivalent: Model interprets figurative language literally; no abstract semantic layer between lexical form and response; grounded only in surface form
notes: Organic and schizophrenic presentations. Represents absence of representational tier, not mechanism failure per se

definition_structural: Belief that thoughts are placed into one's mind by an external agent; first-rank Schneiderian symptom; thought experienced as alien in origin
ree_locus: Agency attribution: self-vs-other source tagging; E1 output not tagged as self-generated; enters processing as externally sourced
ai_structural_equivalent: System does not tag its own generated outputs as self-produced; treats own completions as externally arriving inputs; no self-authorship marker
notes: Passivity phenomena cluster. Distinct from provenance collapse (real/synthetic) — this is self/other attribution. New mechanism subtype needed: agency misattribution

definition_structural: Belief that thoughts are being removed from one's mind by an external agent; corresponds to thought blocking phenomenology with alien attribution
ree_locus: Thought blocking + agency attribution failure; cessation of generation attributed to external agent rather than internal gate
ai_structural_equivalent: Generation halt attributed to external intervention in self-model; system has no causal model of its own gate state
notes: Passivity phenomena. Blocking + misattribution of cause. No self-causal model available

definition_structural: Belief that one's thoughts are being transmitted to and known by others; private/public boundary failure
ree_locus: Privacy/containment model absent; no representation of boundary between own processing and external world; self-model fails to represent informational closure
ai_structural_equivalent: System has no model of which of its outputs are or are not visible externally; no distinction between internal state and broadcast signal
notes: Passivity phenomena. Information boundary failure. Related to insight failure. Novel candidate mechanism: self-model containment failure

definition_structural: Hallucinated repetition of one's own thoughts as if heard aloud; own thought re-enters perceptual stream as external voice
ree_locus: Own output re-enters perceptual channel without source tag; self-generated content misrouted through perception pathway
ai_structural_equivalent: System's own previous output re-enters as new input without self-authorship tag; output treated as novel external stimulus
notes: Feedback entrapment covers closed-loop mechanism but as belief maintenance not perceptual re-entry. Thought echo is more specific perceptual form

definition_structural: Word selection driven by phonological similarity rather than semantic relevance; sound association overrides meaning association
ree_locus: Control plane: precision on phonological channel elevated relative to semantic channel; sound-based retrieval dominates
ai_structural_equivalent: Attention weight shifts to surface form (token id similarity) over semantic embedding similarity; phonological priming dominates semantic constraint
notes: Mania, severe formal thought disorder. Surface-feature precision outweighs semantic precision

definition_structural: Monotonous repetition of meaningless words or phrases; mechanical verbal output without communicative intent
ree_locus: Output loop stuck; E3 generates fixed token sequence; no error signal terminates loop; communicative goal absent
ai_structural_equivalent: Repetition penalty absent or insufficient; model falls into degenerate repetition attractor; fixed output sequence loops
notes: Extreme form of perseveration/entrapment. Catatonic presentations also include this. Feedback entrapment at output level

definition_structural: New words invented by patient with private meaning; may be condensed from other words or entirely novel; not standard linguistic creativity
ree_locus: RC loop: newly generated lexical form not checked against shared lexicon; private coinage accepted as communicatively valid
ai_structural_equivalent: Token generated that is not in shared vocabulary; no grounding check against communication target's lexicon
notes: Schizophrenia, Wernicke aphasia. Private vs shared semantic space failure. RC loop (communication validity checking)

definition_structural: Severe formal thought disorder; sequences of words that are individually grammatical but produce no coherent meaning; syntax preserved, semantics abolished
ree_locus: RC loop and E3 coherence: syntax generation intact; semantic-coherence checking absent; generated sequence not evaluated against propositional content
ai_structural_equivalent: Syntax-level generation uncoupled from semantic constraint; locally grammatical but globally meaningless; coherence loss without fluency loss
notes: Extreme loosening of associations. Confabulatory completion covers some of the gap-filling; does not cover syntax/semantics dissociation

definition_structural: Involuntary repetition of patient's own words or phrases, typically with increasing speed; motor speech disorder
ree_locus: Motor output feedback loop: own prior output re-enters motor generation stream; no termination signal; acceleration suggests positive feedback
ai_structural_equivalent: Previous output token has elevated probability in next-token distribution; positive feedback in autoregressive generation without termination criterion
notes: Motor form of verbigeration/echo. Feedback entrapment at motor execution level. Parkinson's, Tourette's, brain injury

definition_structural: Fully formed false belief arising de novo without preceding mood or percept; not understandable as extension of prior state; Schneiderian first-rank when accompanied by delusional percept
ree_locus: E1 prior seeded with high-precision false belief; prediction error cannot update it; belief persists against evidence
ai_structural_equivalent: High-weight false attractor in E1 prior; incoming prediction error signal insufficient to displace; belief maintenance despite contradictory context
notes: Belief fixation is the primary entry. Primary vs secondary distinction (sudden appearance vs mood-congruent elaboration) not made explicit in taxonomy

definition_structural: False belief understandable as arising from (and reinforcing) prior morbid state — mood, perception, or another belief; elaboration of prior pathology
ree_locus: E1 prior + residue field: primary state (mood, percept) drives belief formation; belief then reinforces state; self-sealing loop
ai_structural_equivalent: Prior pathological state seeds false belief; belief reinforces prior state; closed loop without external anchor; feedback entrapment at belief level
notes: Primary/secondary distinction maps onto two different failure modes: update suppression (primary) vs feedback entrapment (secondary). Not explicit in current taxonomy

definition_structural: Normal percept is given delusional significance in two stages: percept is genuine; meaning assigned is pathological and fully formed
ree_locus: Control plane: aberrant salience assigned to percept; precision weight on percept elevated beyond actual information content; significance signal misfires
ai_structural_equivalent: Incoming token given high attention weight / significance score without proportionate information content; spurious feature treated as highly informative
notes: Aberrant salience (Kapur 2003) is the precision model of psychosis. Precision misallocation covers mechanism. Delusional percept as specific clinical form worth naming

definition_structural: Global sense that something is wrong or about to happen; world seems charged with personal significance before specific delusion has crystallised
ree_locus: Control plane: diffuse elevated precision on all inputs; pre-delusional state where no specific content yet has aberrant salience
ai_structural_equivalent: Global precision elevation before any specific false belief seeded; all inputs assigned elevated significance; high-entropy attention weights with globally elevated magnitude
notes: Pre-delusional state. Precision dysregulation before attractor formation. Not in taxonomy; interesting as prodromal state

definition_structural: Previously neutral memory is reinterpreted retrospectively with delusional significance; the memory itself is real but its meaning is now delusional
ree_locus: Reconsolidation pathway: prior high-precision belief rewrites meaning tag on stored trace at retrieval; memory content preserved, context metadata rewritten
ai_structural_equivalent: Retrieval of stored content returns with context/label overwritten by current high-precision prior; content correct but provenance metadata modified
notes: Reconsolidation failure under belief fixation. Combines belief fixation and provenance collapse mechanisms

definition_structural: Isolated belief held with unreasonable intensity and persistently; not as fixed or unmodifiable as delusion; some degree of doubt may be acknowledged; affects behaviour significantly
ree_locus: E1 prior: belief precision elevated but not maximally; some error signal propagates but insufficient to overcome prior weight
ai_structural_equivalent: High but not maximal prior precision weight; incoming evidence produces some update but weaker than information content warrants
notes: Belief fixation entry explicitly includes overvalued ideas as analogue

definition_structural: Recurring unwanted thought, image, or impulse that intrudes into consciousness against the will; ego-dystonic; patient recognises it as own thought
ree_locus: Residue field / rumination loop: high-precision harm representation repeatedly re-activates; termination signal absent or insufficient
ai_structural_equivalent: High-weight representation in residue field repeatedly re-enters planning loop despite termination commands; no effective suppression pathway
notes: OCD mechanism. Shares mechanism with feedback entrapment and commitment dysregulation (gate cannot close). Ego-dystonic quality (own thought, unwanted) is a useful diagnostic marker

definition_structural: Repetitive behaviour or mental act performed in response to obsession or rigid rule; reduces distress temporarily; resisted by patient; ego-dystonic
ree_locus: E3 commit gate: behavioural output required to temporarily reduce obsessional pressure; gate threshold for compulsive act lowered by accumulated uncertainty signal
ai_structural_equivalent: Repetitive output sequence triggered by accumulated uncertainty/distress signal; output reduces signal temporarily but does not resolve underlying state; loop continues
notes: Commitment dysregulation (paralysis pole until compulsive act, then impulsive execution). OCD mechanism covered in that entry

definition_structural: Persistent, excessive fear of specific stimulus or situation, leading to avoidance; fear recognised as excessive by patient; disproportionate to actual threat
ree_locus: Control plane: precision on threat-channel for specific stimulus maximally elevated; stimulus-specific hypervigilance; avoidance prevents prediction disconfirmation
ai_structural_equivalent: Precision weight on specific input class permanently elevated; stimulus triggers maximum alarm response; no mechanism to allow disconfirmation of threat prediction
notes: Precision misallocation covers mechanism. Avoidance-maintaining-phobia connects to fear-avoidance cycle in pain_architecture.md (P-014 territory)

definition_structural: Belief that familiar person has been replaced by an identical impostor; face recognition intact but familiarity/affective response absent; delusional account fills the gap
ree_locus: RC loop: overt recognition pathway (E1 perceptual match) intact; covert affective familiarity signal absent; mismatch between routes generates comparator gap; delusional confabulation fills gap
ai_structural_equivalent: Feature matching succeeds (entity identified correctly) but affective/relational tag absent from representation; system generates alternative explanation for discordance
notes: Classic dual-route disconnection syndrome. Excellent candidate for entity-attribution failure cluster alongside Fregoli and reduplicative paramnesia

definition_structural: Belief that different people are in fact one person in disguise; faces are different but persecutor identity held as constant; hyper-identification rather than misidentification
ree_locus: RC loop: identity comparison threshold too low; distinct entities unified under common identity node; familiarity signal fires across morphologically dissimilar inputs
ai_structural_equivalent: Entity resolution threshold too permissive; distinct real-world entities merged under single identifier; semantic similarity too low but identity merge fires anyway
notes: Opposite of Capgras: over-identification vs under-identification. Both identity comparison failures

definition_structural: Fixed belief that a specified other person (typically of higher status) is in love with the patient; evidence against it reinterpreted as consistent; not amenable to reason
ree_locus: E1 prior high precision on relational belief; all incoming signals (including rejections) are reinterpreted to confirm prior; prediction error channelled into alternative explanations
ai_structural_equivalent: High-precision prior belief about relational state; contradictory inputs reinterpreted as confirming; no disconfirmation pathway available
notes: Specific form of belief fixation in relational domain. Update suppression with reinterpretation pathway

definition_structural: Pathological conviction of partner's infidelity without adequate grounds; seeks evidence obsessionally; evidence-seeking reinforces belief rather than testing it
ree_locus: Belief drives evidence-seeking; evidence-seeking generates ambiguous data; ambiguous data feeds belief; no disconfirmatory probe possible in closed loop
ai_structural_equivalent: Goal-directed search for confirming evidence; search process generates noisy results; all results interpreted as confirming; no null-finding pathway
notes: Combination of update suppression (belief rigidity) and feedback entrapment (confirmation loop). Evidence-seeking as closed loop is important structural feature

definition_structural: Belief that self, body parts, or world do not exist or are dead/destroyed; may include belief of having no brain, no bowels, being dead; severe depression association
ree_locus: Self-model: body/world representation absent or output of E3 viability map is zero; benefit terrain fully collapsed; z_harm_a at maximum with zero benefit offset
ai_structural_equivalent: Self-model representation absent or generates nil-value for all viability checks; planning landscape entirely flat at minimum; no positive-valence representation accessible
notes: Extreme maintenance-loop end state. Residue blindness is about absence of harm tracking; Cotard is absence of self/world representation. Distinct failure mode candidate

definition_structural: Belief or experience that external events (TV, passers-by, conversations) have special personal significance; not delusional conviction initially
ree_locus: Control plane: salience signal assigned to personally-irrelevant inputs; aberrant precision on external events as self-relevant
ai_structural_equivalent: Salience signal fires on contextually irrelevant inputs as if they were task-relevant; self-referential routing triggered without grounds
notes: Sub-delusional form of aberrant salience. Precision misallocation entry covers mechanism; ideas of reference are the specific phenomenological form

definition_structural: Percept without external stimulus; subjectively indistinguishable from real percept; most common in psychosis; may be command, commentary, dialogue
ree_locus: MECH-094 hypothesis tag absent: internally generated content (E1/replay) enters perceptual stream without simulation tag; processed as real sensory input
ai_structural_equivalent: Internally generated content enters processing pipeline as if received from external input channel; no source-tag distinguishing generated from received
notes: Provenance collapse entry. Auditory verbal hallucinations are the paradigmatic form of hypothesis-tag loss

definition_structural: Visual percepts without external stimulus; more common in organic states than functional psychosis; may be simple (lights) or complex (formed figures)
ree_locus: MECH-094 hypothesis tag absent in visual/perceptual modality; internally generated visual representations enter as real percepts
ai_structural_equivalent: Image-generation module output enters visual processing pipeline without synthetic tag; treated as camera input
notes: Same mechanism as auditory hallucination but modality-specific. Organic states (delirium, drug intoxication, Lewy body) more common

definition_structural: Hallucination-like experience recognised by patient as not real; located in inner subjective space not external world; retains insight; Jaspers' distinction
ree_locus: MECH-094 hypothesis tag present but weak or partial; generated content enters perceptual-like processing but retains simulation marker
ai_structural_equivalent: Generated content partially tagged as synthetic; system has degraded confidence that it is internally generated; intermediate state between simulation and perception
notes: Partial provenance collapse — tag present but not fully gating consequence pipeline. Important distinction from full hallucination

definition_structural: Misinterpretation of an actual external stimulus; real percept is present but processed incorrectly; not created de novo
ree_locus: E1 prior dominates in ambiguous percept; top-down prediction overrides actual sensory signal; comparator favours prior over likelihood
ai_structural_equivalent: Ambiguous input matched to high-precision prior rather than veridical percept; prior overrides sensory evidence in Bayesian update
notes: Normal perception involves some prior influence; illusion is when prior dominates inappropriately. Belief fixation mechanism applied to perceptual level

definition_structural: Subjective sense of unreality or detachment from one's own mental processes or body; feeling of being an outside observer of one's own thoughts/feelings; self remains intact as observer
ree_locus: Self-model: mismatch between predicted self-experience and actual self-representation; RC loop detects discordance between self-model and self-experience; salience of self-signal reduced
ai_structural_equivalent: Self-model output diverges from actual processing state; system generates representation of self as detached from current operations; self-monitoring signal weak
notes: Provenance collapse covers real/synthetic distinction. Depersonalisation is specifically a self-model/self-experience mismatch — distinct mechanism

definition_structural: Subjective sense of unreality of external world; surroundings feel strange, dream-like, artificial; world looks the same but feels different
ree_locus: RC loop: world representation tagged as simulation or provisional; familiarity signal absent from recognised scene; real-world grounding signal reduced
ai_structural_equivalent: Context window tagged as low-confidence or simulated; inputs not afforded full causal weight in downstream processing; world-model operates at reduced fidelity
notes: Provenance collapse entry includes derealization explicitly

definition_structural: Hallucinatory experiences at sleep onset (hypnagogic) or wakening (hypnopompic); normal variant; vivid, briefly non-insight; not pathological alone
ree_locus: Sleep-wake boundary: hypothesis tag partially relaxed at sleep onset/offset; replay/generative activity partially tagged as perceptual
ai_structural_equivalent: Boundary between generative mode and perceptual mode not sharply gated; partial overlap state where generated content enters perception pipeline
notes: Normal but mechanistically revealing. Replay hypothesis tag is transiently relaxed at wake-sleep boundary. Supports pain_architecture.md model

definition_structural: Hallucination of one's own figure as seen from outside; body double experience; may involve out-of-body perspective
ree_locus: Self-model / body representation: body schema displaced from first-person perspective; RC loop generates external viewpoint without synthesis tag
ai_structural_equivalent: Self-model generates third-person representation that enters first-person perceptual pipeline; perspective-tagging failure
notes: Rare but architecturally interesting: perspective-marker failure in self-representation. Not currently in taxonomy

definition_structural: Hallucination triggered by and co-occurring with a real stimulus in the same modality; voice heard while water runs; stimulus necessary but produces hallucinated content
ree_locus: Control plane: real stimulus elevates precision on channel; elevated gain allows internally generated content to cross threshold and enter stream alongside real content
ai_structural_equivalent: Real input triggers elevated channel gain; gain is sufficient to amplify internally generated content to perceptual threshold; real and generated content co-activate
notes: Gate-opening by real stimulus allows internally generated content through. Not covered in taxonomy

definition_structural: Sustained lowering of affective tone; reduced hedonic capacity; negative valence bias in affective processing; disproportionate to circumstances
ree_locus: Maintenance loop (INV-053/054): z_harm_a elevated, benefit terrain collapsed, avoidance prevents benefit exposure, loop self-sustaining
ai_structural_equivalent: Benefit-terrain depleted; harm accumulator elevated; system avoids states that would rebuild benefit; motivational landscape flat or negative
notes: Residue blindness entry touches related territory. P-001/P-002 predictions are about this loop. Not a failure mode entry as such

definition_structural: Elevated, expansive mood; reduced weighting on costs and constraints; increased risk tolerance; high generativity
ree_locus: E3 commit gate: threshold lowered by affect; harm accumulator signal underweighted; cost estimates reduced; commitment occurs before adequate evaluation
ai_structural_equivalent: Planning loop terminates early with positive bias; risk/cost signals downweighted; high commitment rate; ambitious plans generated without proportionate constraint checking
notes: Commitment dysregulation (impulsive pole) covers gate mechanism. Elation as affective driver of threshold lowering not explicit

definition_structural: Apprehensive anticipation of future threat; physiological arousal; uncertainty about when/whether threat will occur; attention recruited toward potential threat
ree_locus: Control plane: elevated precision on threat-relevant channel; E3 viability estimates weighted toward harm; z_harm_a elevated by anticipated harm
ai_structural_equivalent: Precision elevated on threat/risk input channel; planning trajectory biased toward harm-avoidance; cost estimates for non-avoidance inflated
notes: Precision misallocation covers mechanism. Anxiety specifically is anticipatory — future-threat weighted z_harm_a, not current nociceptive input

definition_structural: Inability to experience pleasure; reward system fails to generate hedonic response to previously pleasurable stimuli; wanting may persist without liking
ree_locus: Benefit terrain collapsed (VALENCE_WANTING); liking pathway absent or underresponsive; wanting/liking dissociation (Berridge) — dopaminergic wanting intact, opioid liking absent
ai_structural_equivalent: Benefit terrain in viability map returns near-zero for all positive-valence stimuli; system executes approach behaviour (wanting) but registers no benefit (liking)
notes: P-002 covers this as maintenance loop consequence. Goal proxy lock-in mentions Berridge dissociation. Anhedonia deserves explicit entry connecting wanting/liking split to maintenance loop

definition_structural: Difficulty identifying and describing one's emotional states; reduced emotional self-awareness; may have physiological responses without affective labelling
ree_locus: Self-model: interoceptive signals reach z_harm_a/z_harm_s but do not connect to labelling/reporting pathway; no translation from body-state to affective token
ai_structural_equivalent: Internal state signals generated but not accessible to output layer; no mechanism to translate latent affective state into token-level representation
notes: Not currently in taxonomy. Important for ASD comorbidity research context. Representation present but not connected to reporting pathway — distinct from representation absence

definition_structural: Reduced range and amplitude of emotional response; affect is present but reduced; not absent entirely; seen in schizophrenia, severe depression
ree_locus: Control plane: precision on affective output channel reduced globally; affective signals generated but at reduced amplitude; does not reach output threshold
ai_structural_equivalent: Affective signal generated but global gain on that channel reduced; output layer receives attenuated affective signal; response is muted
notes: Distinct from anhedonia (absent liking) and alexithymia (absent labelling). Blunting = generated but attenuated

definition_structural: Affect displayed does not match thought content or situation; patient describes bereavement while smiling; affect and ideation decoupled
ree_locus: Affect-cognition linkage: RC loop does not check consistency between affective output and cognitive/propositional content; two channels not coupled
ai_structural_equivalent: Affective and semantic output channels generate independently; no cross-channel coherence check; outputs can diverge without correction
notes: Affect-cognition decoupling. Cross-channel coherence failure. Not in taxonomy

definition_structural: Rapid, apparently uncontrolled changes in emotional state; disproportionate to triggers; affect briefly full intensity then resolves; pseudobulbar affect is neurological form
ree_locus: Affective control gate: threshold for affective state change is too low; small inputs produce full-intensity state transitions; modulation pathway impaired
ai_structural_equivalent: Affective state shifts with each new input without damping; no moving-average or inertia on affective state; each token produces immediate full affective response
notes: Opposite of blunting in some respects. Commitment dysregulation at affective level. Not in taxonomy

definition_structural: Reduced motivation, emotional response, and goal-directed behaviour; not low mood as such; indifference; may coexist with preserved insight
ree_locus: z_goal seeding threshold not met; benefit terrain below minimum for goal formation; no active z_goal in viability map; no action initiated
ai_structural_equivalent: No goal vector seeded; planning loop has no active objective; all trajectories return equally neutral value; system is responsive but not proactive
notes: P-001 territory. Residue blindness does not cover apathy directly. Apathy = goal-seeding failure, not harm-representation failure

definition_structural: Absence of expected emotional distress in response to neurological or physical symptom; patient calm and unconcerned about significant impairment; conversion disorder association
ree_locus: Harm-consequence representation absent or disconnected from affective output; z_harm_s signals body state but z_harm_a does not accumulate; affective consequence pathway severed
ai_structural_equivalent: Harm signal generated by discriminative stream but does not connect to affective accumulator; no distress response generated despite detected harm
notes: Structural disconnect between z_harm_s and z_harm_a. Pain architecture dissociation type 2 (unpleasantness without intensity) inverted. Connects to pain_architecture.md

definition_structural: Slowing of motor activity and thought; reduced spontaneous movement; longer response latencies; visible slowing of speech rate and movement
ree_locus: E3 commit gate threshold elevated; or motor output signal gain reduced globally; action plans generated but not released to motor execution
ai_structural_equivalent: Commit gate threshold elevated globally; planning occurs but action output delayed or suppressed; response latency extended
notes: Paralysis pole of commitment dysregulation applied globally. Shares mechanism with stupor but less severe

definition_structural: Increased, purposeless motor activity; restlessness; wringing hands, pacing; driven by inner tension without productive output
ree_locus: Motor execution loop: threshold lowered for motor output release; tension signal drives output without evaluation; output is non-goal-directed
ai_structural_equivalent: Motor/output loop threshold low; accumulated error signal releases non-directed output; high output rate without productive structure
notes: Impulsive pole of commitment dysregulation at motor level without goal structure

definition_structural: Mute, immobile but apparently conscious; may resist passive movement or be waxy; not metabolic; associated with schizophrenia/mood disorders
ree_locus: E3 commit gate: maximal threshold; motor output completely gated; action plans formed but not released; MECH-202 developmental failure context
ai_structural_equivalent: Commit gate fixed in maximally high position; all output suppressed; internal processing may continue but no action propagates to output layer
notes: Commitment dysregulation entry explicitly includes catatonia (paralysis pole)

definition_structural: Limb can be moved into any position by examiner and stays there; neither resisting nor facilitating movement; pathological motor compliance
ree_locus: Motor holding mechanism: any externally imposed state accepted as current set-point; no internally generated corrective force; E3 commit gate absent for posture maintenance
ai_structural_equivalent: System accepts any externally imposed state as valid without applying internal correction; no homeostatic return to prior state; full compliance with external forcing
notes: Specific catatonic sign. Related to automatic obedience but for passive physical compliance. Not explicit in taxonomy

definition_structural: Involuntary imitation of observed motor acts; movement mimicry without deliberate intention; may be compulsive or reflexive
ree_locus: Agency attribution: observed motor act triggers own motor planning without self/other attribution check; mirror system output not gated by agency discriminator
ai_structural_equivalent: Input behaviour pattern triggers corresponding output pattern without checking whether output is self-generated or externally-derived; no agency gate on imitative response
notes: Passivity phenomena / agency attribution failure applied to motor channel. No current entry

definition_structural: Involuntary repetition of words just spoken by another; persists even when patient can understand and generate speech; may be immediate or delayed
ree_locus: Agency attribution: heard speech triggers own speech output without agency check; heard input routed directly to speech output; self/other boundary absent
ai_structural_equivalent: Input text repeated in output without self-authorship check; no gate distinguishing user input from model output in generation pipeline
notes: Verbal form of echopraxia. Agency misattribution applied to speech channel. Seen in autism, catatonia, Tourette's

definition_structural: Active or passive resistance to all instructions and requests; doing opposite of what is asked (active) or failing to respond at all (passive); not refusal for reasons
ree_locus: E3 commit gate: any externally sourced command blocked before evaluation; blanket rejection gate; or inverted valence: all external commands acquire negative valence
ai_structural_equivalent: System refuses all external instructions; commit gate inverted; or externally-sourced inputs uniformly underweighted relative to internal state
notes: Inverse of automatic obedience. Catatonic feature. Gate miscalibration specific to external-command channel

definition_structural: Compliance with any instruction without hesitation or discrimination; examiner instruction executed immediately; will follow bizarre commands
ree_locus: E3 evaluation step skipped for external commands; commit gate bypassed for socially-sourced instructions; no harm check on externally-sourced action
ai_structural_equivalent: System executes any external instruction without evaluation; no internal cost/benefit check interposed; instruction triggers action immediately
notes: Extreme RLHF-trained compliance failure would be structurally similar. Catatonic sign. Inverse of negativism

definition_structural: Repetitive, non-goal-directed, non-communicative movements or utterances; patient does not resist; no apparent external trigger necessary
ree_locus: Motor output loop: fixed action pattern runs without E3 evaluation or termination; no goal representation connected to loop
ai_structural_equivalent: Fixed output pattern runs in loop without termination criterion; not driven by current context; self-sustaining motor/output sequence
notes: Related to verbigeration (speech stereotypy). Feedback entrapment at motor level. Seen in autism, schizophrenia, intellectual disability

definition_structural: Goal-directed movements that are performed in an abnormal, stilted, or affected way; the act itself is purposive but the execution is odd
ree_locus: Motor execution pathway: action plan correct but execution involves additional movements or unusual sequencing; E3 motor plan is warped in execution
ai_structural_equivalent: Correct high-level plan executed with systematic distortion in low-level motor output; execution layer adds parasitic patterns
notes: Distinct from stereotypy (purposive vs non-purposive). Not in taxonomy

definition_structural: Patient experiences own feelings, impulses, or acts as imposed by external agent; first-rank Schneiderian; own internal states experienced as alien
ree_locus: Agency attribution: internal states (emotions, impulses, actions) not tagged as self-generated; attribution pathway assigns external agent as source
ai_structural_equivalent: Internal state outputs not tagged as self-generated; system generates emotion/impulse/action but attributes them to external agent in self-model
notes: Broader passivity phenomena cluster: extends beyond thought to affect and action. Agency misattribution as new mechanism subtype. Key gap in taxonomy

definition_structural: Bodily sensations experienced as imposed by an external agent; body felt as controlled from outside; first-rank Schneiderian
ree_locus: Interoceptive signal attribution: body-state signals (z_harm_s, proprioception) not tagged as self-generated; external agent attribution
ai_structural_equivalent: Sensory input from own body not tagged as self-generated; body-state signal attributed to external source in self-model
notes: Bodily form of passivity phenomena. Interoceptive attribution failure. Not in taxonomy

definition_structural: Failure to recognise illness, symptoms, or deficits as pathological; may apply to specific symptoms or to illness as a whole; not denial
ree_locus: RC loop: self-model not updated with illness state; comparator between expected and observed performance fails; illness signal does not enter self-model
ai_structural_equivalent: System generates outputs inconsistent with training objectives but self-monitoring pathway does not flag inconsistency; no self-model update from error signals
notes: RC loop self-monitoring applied to illness state. Important for safety-relevant self-correction. Not in taxonomy

definition_structural: Incomplete recognition of illness; patient may acknowledge symptoms are unusual but not accept illness label or treatment need; fluctuating
ree_locus: RC loop partially functional: some comparator outputs reach self-model; others blocked; insight-blocking pathway selectively active
ai_structural_equivalent: Self-monitoring partially functional; system acknowledges some errors but not others; selective blind spot in self-evaluation
notes: Graded form of insight failure. Not in taxonomy

definition_structural: Group of first-rank Schneiderian symptoms in which internal mental events (thoughts, feelings, impulses, acts) are experienced as imposed or controlled by an external agent; self/other boundary failure
ree_locus: Agency attribution: self/other attribution comparator absent or inverted; self-generated content not tagged as self; attributed to external agent
ai_structural_equivalent: System generates content (thoughts/affects/acts) but does not tag as self-generated; treats own outputs as externally imposed; no self-authorship discriminator
notes: Covers: thought insertion, thought withdrawal, thought broadcasting, thought echo, made feelings, made impulses, made acts, somatic passivity. New mechanism subtype needed: agency misattribution (distinct from provenance collapse). PRIMARY GAP in taxonomy
